verdict.rationale: Zep documents official SDKs: an installable Python package (`pip install zep-cloud`) with client methods such as `client.graph.edge.delete`, and an SDK Reference with per-language code samples across about 150 endpoints. A versioned SDK migration map covers Python, TypeScript and Go, and dated deprecation waves are published. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality and usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: A method-by-method map from the Zep v3 SDK to v4, plus the behavior changes that need more than a rename
The V2 SDK is being deprecated in favor of the V3 SDK
